prompt: Order the body of `dl_insert_after`, which links a new node in right after `pos`. The new node must be wired up before the old links change. One line does not belong.
lines: if (pos->next) pos->next->prev = n; else l->tail = n;
explain: First build the new node and point it at both neighbours (`prev` is `pos`, `next` is the old `pos->next`). Then fix the node after it (or the tail), and only last make `pos->next` point at the new node. Changing `pos->next` earlier would lose the old neighbour.
